children.text: Modular Haki Staircases for Fast, Safe Access
Need safe and secure access across scaffold levels? We supply Haki staircases in multiple heights, with customisable options to suit your site and layout.
Quick to Install, Easy to Use

Our stair towers come in 1m, 1.5m, and 2m flight heights, giving you flexible options for multi-level access. They’re ideal for larger scaffold builds and complex projects where ladder access isn’t practical.
Every staircase is fitted by trained professionals, and optional security features can be added to prevent unauthorised site access.
Built with Safety at the Core
Haki staircases offer exceptional stability and ease of use. Whether for long-term use or short-term hire, our systems ensure your team can move safely and confidently between scaffold levels.
With full compliance and quick installation, they’re the ideal solution for keeping your team moving — safely and securely.

Protect your work from unpredictable weather with reliable temporary roof scaffolding. We build structures to shield your site, your materials, and your schedule.
Weather-Resistant Structures Built to Last

Whether it’s a two-day repair or a two-month renovation, our temporary roofing systems provide effective weatherproofing and site safety. Designed to protect both workers and property, they allow you to maintain productivity without worrying about the forecast.
Each roof is customised to fit your site, with designs that are fast to erect, safe to use, and fully compliant with UK scaffolding standards.
Protection That Keeps Your Project on Track

Our roof scaffolds are a practical solution for open-roof works, property renovations, and structural repairs. They help reduce weather delays and minimise water damage, giving your team a secure environment to work in.
We’ve provided temporary roofing for everything from single-storey homes to large industrial buildings — always delivered with speed, safety, and precision.

children.text: Scaffold Design Services for Any Project

Tower Scaffold + Safety Netting, we offer professional scaffold design and calculation services tailored to your site’s needs. From small-scale builds to complex industrial projects, our safety-first approach ensures every scaffold starts with a solid plan.
Expert Planning with Full Compliance

Every project is unique — that’s why our scaffold designs are created in partnership with experienced engineers to meet your exact specifications. We work with you to develop safe, practical, and fully compliant structures, ensuring seamless integration into your build schedule.

Our designs cover a wide range of scaffold types, from independent scaffolds to complex builds such as bridges, loading bays, and temporary roofs. All plans include the necessary risk assessments and calculation reports, ready for inspection or approval.
Tailored Solutions for Complex Requirements

We specialise in scaffolding for challenging environments where standard setups won’t cut it. Our design service is ideal for unique builds like heavy-duty loading bays, shoring systems, and bridge access — always created with precision and site-specific planning.
Whether your project demands extra stability, higher weight loads, or specific spatial configurations, we deliver scaffold designs that match your goals while meeting strict UK safety regulations.

services.name: Safety Netting
services.title: Safety Netting Installation | Fall Protection Southampton & Hampshire
services.description: FASET-qualified safety netting & fall protection installed to BS EN standards. Reduce risk on worksites across Southampton & Hampshire with Tower Scaffold + Safety Netting. Get a tailored quote now.

children.text: Certified Safety Netting for Safer Worksites
Protect your team from falls with fully certified safety netting. At Tower Scaffold + Safety Netting, we install fall arrest systems that meet strict UK standards.
Specialist Installations by Qualified Riggers

Our safety netting is manufactured to BS EN 1263-1 standards and installed by FASET-qualified riggers. Every team member holds CSCS and IPAF certifications, ensuring installations are safe, professional, and regulation-ready.
Ideal for roofing works, high-level repairs, or steel frame construction — we deliver fall protection that reduces risk without compromising workflow.
Trusted by Builders Across the UK

We work with main contractors and independent builders to provide edge protection and safety netting that’s quick to install and easy to inspect. Whether it’s a large industrial job or a compact domestic build, we make safety simple.
Our systems comply with BS EN 1263-2 and BS 8411 standards, giving you peace of mind that every height hazard is under control.
The Importance of Edge Protection

Edge protection plays a vital role in preventing falls from height, acting as a physical barrier along open edges. When combined with safety netting, it adds an extra layer of protection, helping to safeguard both workers and the public below. At Tower Scaffold + Safety Netting, we integrate reliable edge protection into all our setups to ensure full compliance with UK safety standards.
